optimizer: AdamW, same decay treatment for all parameter tensors as prior experiments
objective: BCE on all 4755 training questions; same objective for both architectures and every variant
sampling: Full training permutation per epoch, seed+10000; identical question order for paired seeds
normalization: Per-dimension train-only mean/std; unchanged 1024D embeddings, no question features
architecture: Exact copy of previous CandidateScorer. Width changes projection and attention/FFN width; score-head intermediate width stays 64. Four attention heads remain fixed. Dropout30 changes every existing dropout site, including attention-weight dropout.
checkpoint_selection: Highest official validation correct count, then lowest validation BCE, then earliest epoch
learning_rate_selection: Seed 17: highest official validation correct count, then lowest validation BCE; exact ties prefer first listed LR
final_selection: Highest five-seed mean official validation accuracy; ties lower parameter count then protocol order. Fixed seed17 single model, no ensemble
diagnostics: At initialization and every epoch: full train and validation measured in eval mode at identical checkpoint, including BCE and mixed-only BCE. Save epoch10 metrics as common-update diagnostic. Official train and validation accuracy at selected checkpoint. Do not compare stochastic minibatch loss to eval validation loss as a generalization gap.
primary_comparisons: Within architecture, each variant minus baseline. Report validation gains, clean loss gaps, official accuracy gaps, mixed-only diagnostic gaps, parameters and training costs. Smaller gap without higher validation performance is not evidence of improvement.
secondary_comparisons: Baseline-seed17 selected learning-rate matched comparison using the already-run two-LR seed17 searches; exploratory, one seed only. Architecture differences are descriptive, not parameter-matched.
uncertainty: 10000 paired question bootstrap draws on seed-mean correctness differences; conditional exploratory intervals, reused validation set, no multiple-comparison correction. Report per-seed deltas and other-four-seed mean.
test_policy: No test training/selection/predictions/scoring. Official integrity checker may check test file integrity/alignment.
